review_conclusion.key_finding: LX_2024 contributes 15 experimentally prepared, product-characterized aldehyde tails spanning aromatic diester and triester architectures. All 15 pass the frozen Ugi forward transform with exactly one sanitized product, so they expand route-grounded Ugi aldehyde support without inheriting the source lipid products or biological labels. One invalid and one extra LNPDB tail record remain explicitly reconciled, and the A3-6b fatty-acid naming conflict is preserved.

source_component_scope.count_note: The source reports a 12 by 15 reductive-amination library. LNPDB links 12 normalized heads and 16 tail1 records to this PMID. Fourteen source aldehydes match parsed LNPDB structures, A2-8 is recovered from a source structure whose LNPDB string has a trailing underscore, and one extra parsed LNPDB triheptanoate record is not among the 15 source-reported aldehydes.
